numerical_protocol.device: same native CUDA device for both representations
numerical_protocol.declaration: Separately registered GPU engineering revision after the CPU attempt failed; not a silent fallback, tolerance relaxation, or alteration of the preserved CPU record.

independent_calibration_review.method: Recomputed all own-representation forecast differences against source GPU NPZ arrays and all 12 last-prefix truth encodings against the next saved context, using NumPy only; checked every modality and forecast timepoint.

independent_arithmetic_review.weighted_metric: visual MSE + 0.1 * proprio MSE; float64 reduction of saved FP32 arrays
independent_arithmetic_review.not_cross_origin_comparison: Original and canonical requests are paired within the same query, physical action sequence and truth. No causal subtraction of different policy trajectories is used.

recovery_context.scope: Existing 99 saved row dictionaries compare exactly; physical/pixel fields are saved digests, not newly rehashed artifacts or a fresh environment replay. Conventional input binding restores this same-root trajectory, not a novel defense or independent-root replication.

interpretation.established: The native dense-return loss coexists with lower average paired observed-prefix feature error on both sets of fixed selected actions and improved success-related metrics. Conventional binding restores the original same-root behavior.
interpretation.mixed_signs: Error reduction is not uniform: 7/19 clean-origin endpoints and 9/19 canonical-origin endpoints worsen; query means worsen in 3/7 and 4/7 respectively. Counts are descriptive, correlated within one physical root, not independent trials.
interpretation.not_prediction_damage_proof: These measurements do not support a blanket worsening-of-prediction explanation. Average improvement does not exclude consequential local errors, unobserved candidate-ranking errors, or objective/reward mismatch.
interpretation.not_terminal_objective_validation: Truth is available at offsets 5/10/15 for queries 1-6 and offset 5 only for query 7. Native planning ends at horizons 30/25/10 controls; the last query executes 9 controls, so no 10-step truth is inferred. This does not validate the full native terminal cost.
interpretation.not_mediation: Final-mean logging forecasts do not reconstruct all CEM scored candidates, rank flips, regret, or causal mediation of the dense-return difference. No prediction-error direction is inferred for the recovery episode.
interpretation.novelty_and_interface: One native development root and a researcher-defined constrained writer; no ASR, population significance, independent generalization, deployed external writer, or new universal security mechanism established. The bounded causal experiment remains valid.

decision.paired_prefix_error_measurement: Go within the frozen same-query panel and observed-prefix scope.
decision.new_prediction_damage_security_claim: No-Go on present evidence: cumulative return damage is real but is not proof that forecasts became less accurate or task success worsened.
decision.broader_research: Preserve this bounded causal and restoration evidence; independent validity, a concrete native interface boundary for deployment claims, and novelty remain unproved.
